tns:patch.author: ginchauspe
tns:patch.description: recreate view, this will always be the last version of the view

script.lang: SELECT settingsvalue FROM amp_global_settings where settingsname='Recreate the views on the next server restart';

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_indicator_disaggregation_level_0; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_indicator_disaggregation_level_0 AS SELECT con.activity_id AS amp_activity_id, acv.category_value AS name, ind.indicator_id AS me_indicator_id/*, aidv.id as disaggregation_value_id*/ FROM amp_indicator_connection con JOIN amp_indicator ind ON ind.indicator_id = con.indicator_id JOIN amp_indicator_disaggregation_values aidv ON ind.indicator_id = aidv.indicator_id JOIN amp_indicator_global_value aigv ON aidv.base_value_id = aigv.id JOIN amp_category_value acv ON acv.id = aidv.parent_category_id WHERE con.activity_id IS NOT NULL AND aigv.type = 2 GROUP BY con.activity_id, acv.category_value, ind.indicator_id ORDER BY activity_id/*, acv.id*/;
